recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Secretariat engage through the Disarmament, Demobilization and Reintegration Section in a partnership-based reflection on the definition of a common data set, based on the experience from the MINUSMA dashboard, with a view to informing a global dashboard of disarmament, demobilization and reintegration and community violence reduction activities.
